meta.label: CDP Audit Export
meta.description: Lets members of the audit group export the metadata of any project (no data, no folders, no Git history) without holding advanced project permissions. The export runs with an administrative identity and is delivered in a hub project folder.
meta.author: CDP Platform Team

params.name: auditor_group
params.label: Auditor group
params.description: DSS group whose members may run the audit macros.

params.name: restrict_to_hub_project
params.label: Only run from the hub project
params.description: When checked, the macros refuse to run from any other project.

params.name: max_projects_per_run
params.label: Max projects per run
params.description: Upper limit of projects exported by a single macro run.

params.name: hub_project_key
params.label: Hub project key
params.description: Project that receives the exports. The auditor group needs read access to it, nothing more.

params.name: hub_folder
params.label: Hub managed folder
params.description: Name or id of the managed folder, in the hub project, where the archives are written.

params.name: variables_redaction
params.label: Project variables
params.description: How project variable values are treated in the delivered archive. Variable names are always kept.

selectChoices.label: Redact values of secret-looking names only

params.name: sep_identity
params.label: Administrative identity
params.description: Leave the key empty to let DSS generate the privileged client. Fill it only if that helper is not usable on this instance.

params.name: admin_api_key
params.label: Admin API key (optional)
params.description: Global admin API key used for the export instead of the DSS helper.
